sections.title: Access
sections.instructions: Access: this section asks about access to the park/space and about the surrounding area. Do your best to look around the space and its entrances to answer the questions. If asked to rate the condition of a feature consider whether it is poor (Ex: poorly maintained, unsafe, broken and/or dirty), acceptable (Ex: clean, in good shape, well maintained and/or relatively safe) or great (Ex: in really good shape, really well maintained, feels very safe)
sections.commentPrompt: Are there any comments you want to add about the Access of this space? (optional)

questions.prompt: Is there at least 1 public transportation stop (Ex: bus or metro/subway stop) nearby?

followUp.prompt: If yes, please rate the condition that this feature or area is in.

questions.prompt: Are there sidewalks leading to the main entrance to the space?

followUp.prompt: If yes, please rate the condition that this feature or area is in.

questions.prompt: Does this space feel near to or well connected to other community spaces that you like to use?
Does the area or neighborhood surrounding the space feel safe (Ex: from traffic, from strangers, from dangerous people or activities)
Is there signage with details about the space on it (Ex: name of space, open/closing times, space map, event program information, etc)
Are there posted rules about using the space? (Ex: who can use the space or when; activities not allowed, etc)

If asked to rate the condition of a feature consider whether it is poor (Ex: poorly maintained, unsafe, broken and/or dirty), acceptable (Ex: clean, in good shape, well maintained and/or relatively safe) or great (Ex: in really good shape, really well maintained, feels very safe)
sections.commentPrompt: Are there any comments you want to add about the Activity Spaces of this space? (optional)

questions.prompt: Are there sports fields (Ex: football, soccer, baseball, etc.)?

followUp.prompt: If yes, please rate the condition that this feature or area is in.

questions.prompt: Are there any sports/game courts (Ex: basketball, tennis, wall/handball, etc.)?

followUp.prompt: If yes, please rate the condition that this feature or area is in.

questions.prompt: Is there an open field or space (where you could walk, play games, etc.)?

followUp.prompt: If yes, please rate the condition that this feature or area is in.

questions.prompt: Is there a playground or play structure (typically for younger kids)?

followUp.prompt: If yes, please rate the condition that this feature or area is in.

questions.prompt: Is there fixed equipment/features you can play with (Ex: climbing wall, fitness equipment, skate rails or ramps, etc.)?

followUp.prompt: If yes, please rate the condition that this feature or area is in.

questions.prompt: Is there loose equipment available (Ex: basketballs, soccer balls, nets, etc.)?

followUp.prompt: If yes, please rate the condition that this feature or area is in.

questions.prompt: Are there places where you could hang out with a small group of friends?
Are there places where you could gather with a larger group of people (Ex. family parties, community events)?
Are there places where you could be by yourself if you wanted to?
Are there places where you could have privacy if you wanted it (on your own or with others)?

followUp.prompt: If yes, please rate the condition that this feature or area is in.

questions.prompt: Are there places where you can buy food or drinks?
Are there trash and/or recycling bins available?

Are there places to sit with larger groups?

sections.title: Experience of Space
sections.instructions: EXPERIENCE OF THE SPACE: This section asks about how you feel in or experience the space.
sections.commentPrompt: Are there any comments you want to add about the Experience of Space of this space? (optional)

questions.prompt: Are there loud or unpleasant noises?
Is there an opportunity to hear nature sounds (Ex: water, birds, animals)?
Are there interesting and/or colorful things to look at in this space?
Are there scenic views from this space?
Does this place give you opportunities to interact with nature (plants and/or wildlife)?
Is there evidence that the community is involved in or cares about the space (Ex: signs for community events, a community garden, a free book library, etc.)?
Are there historical or educational features in the space (Ex: monuments, displays, educational signs, etc.)?
Are there spaces or features that feel unsafe to use (Ex: tripping hazards, unsafe equipment)
Are there generally people in the space that make you feel afraid or uncomfortable?
Is there evidence of alcohol/drug use that makes this space feel unsafe or uncomfortable?

sections.title: Use & Usability
sections.instructions: Use & Usability: This section asks about how the space can be or is used. If asked to rate the condition of a feature consider whether it is poor (Ex: poorly maintained, unsafe, broken and/or dirty), acceptable (Ex: clean, in good shape, well maintained and/or relatively safe) or great (Ex: in really good shape, really well maintained, feels very safe)

followUp.prompt: If yes, please rate the condition that this feature or area is in.

questions.prompt: Is the space suitable for youth activity programs or events?

followUp.prompt: If yes, please rate the condition that this feature or area is in.

questions.prompt: Does the layout / design of the space feel appropriate for community needs (Ex: is there enough space for activities? Are there some areas that are not used a lot? Are there some spaces / features that feel unnecessary)?
Is there a variety of spaces for different types of activities?
Are there lights present that would allow activity areas to be used at night?
Looking at the recreation facilities or activity areas, would someone who has difficulty walking, seeing, or hearing be able to comfortably use the space?
Can the space always be accessed for use (Ex: the space and all its activity areas are not locked/fenced off at any time)?
Do you have to pay a fee to enter or use this space or any of its activity areas?
